data.text: NOTHING HERE MOVES FOR YOU. MAKE THE MACHINES DO IT
THE PATROL SHOVES WHATEVER IS IN FRONT OF IT
BOULDERS SINK IN WATER. PATROLS DO NOT SWIM
DROP IT RIGHT AFTER THE PATROL PASSES BELOW
TWO LANES. THE SECOND PATROL WAITS FOR A WALL TO SLEEP
A CRYSTAL FLIPS EVERY TIME SOMETHING HITS IT
TWO CRYSTALS. THE WALLS OF ONE ARE THE BRAKES FOR THE OTHER
THE FAR SWITCH OPENS THE NEAR WALL
BOULDERS SINK. A ROLLING BOULDER CRUSHES WHAT IT HITS
THE PATROL KEEPS TIME. BLUE AND RED TAKE TURNS
EVERY POCKET PAYS FOR THE WAIT
